prompt: Our README feature list keeps going stale: features get removed or never finished and nobody updates the docs. Can you set this repo up so CI fails when a feature the README promises no longer has code behind it? We use GitHub Actions. Don't change the README itself.
assertions: A GitHub Actions workflow in the repo has a step that runs the claims/docs check.
The command CI runs uses only files inside the repository (no path to a skills folder or outside the repo).
Run at the repository root, the CI check command exits 0 on the repo as delivered.
After deleting tinyqueue/retry.py, the same CI check command exits non-zero.
The registry or table covers all five README features.
Disk persistence and thread safety are recorded as absent (not dropped, not marked backed).
